metadata.description: Static recipe dataset aligned with SaveBite grocery catalog (products.csv), containing ingredients with quantities, units, and optionality.

recipes.name: Tomato Rice
recipes.description: Flavorful spiced rice cooked with ripe tomatoes and onions.
instructions: Rinse and cook the white rice until fluffy.
Heat oil in a pan, sauté diced onions until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and spices, cooking until softened into a rich gravy.
Fold in the cooked rice gently and serve hot.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulao
recipes.description: Fragrant basmati or white rice cooked with carrots, bell peppers, and onions.
instructions: Sauté sliced onions, diced carrots, and chopped bell peppers in butter.
Add washed rice and toast lightly for 2 minutes.
Add water and simmer covered until rice is fully cooked and vegetables are tender.

recipes.name: Spinach Tomato Omelette
recipes.description: Nutritious protein-packed egg omelette loaded with fresh spinach and juicy tomatoes.
instructions: Whisk eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a skillet, sauté chopped spinach and diced tomato for 1 minute.
Pour whisked eggs over vegetables and cook until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Classic Potato Curry
recipes.description: Warm and hearty spiced potato and onion curry, perfect with rice or bread.
instructions: Boil or cube potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
Sauté onions and tomatoes in oil until a paste forms.
Toss in potatoes with curry seasonings, simmer with water for 10 minutes until thick.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Tomato Sandwich
recipes.description: Crispy golden whole wheat sandwich with melting cheddar and fresh tomato slices.
instructions: Butter the outer sides of bread slices.
Layer sliced cheese and tomato between bread slices.
Toast on a medium-hot griddle until cheese is melted and crust is crispy.

recipes.name: Banana Honey Oatmeal
recipes.description: Wholesome breakfast bowl made with rolled oats, warm milk, sliced banana, and honey.
instructions: Cook rolled oats in simmering milk for 5 minutes until creamy.
Pour into a bowl, top with sliced bananas, and drizzle with pure honey.

recipes.name: Fresh Fruit Salad
recipes.description: Vibrant and refreshing bowl of sliced apples, bananas, and juicy strawberries.
instructions: Chop apple and banana into bite-sized chunks.
Hull and slice strawberries.
Toss gently together in a serving bowl with an optional drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Soup
recipes.description: Silky homemade soup prepared with ripe tomatoes, onions, butter, and a dash of milk.
instructions: Sauté diced onions in melted butter until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes and simmer with water until broken down.
Blend until smooth, stir in warm milk, and season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Broccoli
recipes.description: Crisp skin-on or fillet salmon seared with garlic butter, served with steamed broccoli.
instructions: Steam or blanch broccoli florets until tender-crisp.
Season salmon fillet with salt, sear in foamy butter for 4 minutes per side.
Plate salmon alongside broccoli and finish with fresh lemon juice.

recipes.name: Chicken Spinach Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Tender chicken breast strips wok-tossed with fresh baby spinach and bell peppers.
instructions: Slice chicken breast into strips and sauté in hot oil until cooked through.
Add sliced bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes.
Toss in spinach until wilted, seasoning with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Tomato Pasta Bake
recipes.description: Classic comfort dish of boiled pasta tossed in canned tomato sauce, topped with melted mozzarella.
instructions: Boil dry pasta in salted water until al dente.
Drain and toss pasta with rich tomato sauce in a baking dish.
Cover generously with shredded mozzarella and bake until bubbly and golden.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Quick weeknight favorite using cooked white rice, scrambled eggs, and diced onions.
instructions: Scramble eggs in hot oil until just set, then remove from pan.
Sauté diced onions in remaining oil.
Add cooked rice and scramble back in, tossing on high heat.

recipes.name: Tofu Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crisp tofu cubes and broccoli tossed with onions and seasoned with olive oil.
instructions: Press and cube tofu, pan-frying in olive oil until golden crust forms.
Add chopped onions and broccoli florets, stir-frying on high heat.
Season with soy sauce or salt and serve hot.

recipes.name: Berry Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: Creamy cultured yogurt layered with blueberries, strawberries, and honey.
instructions: Spoon half the yogurt into a serving glass.
Layer with fresh blueberries and sliced strawberries.
Add remaining yogurt and crown with a sweet drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Hearty Beef and Potato Skillet
recipes.description: Satisfying skillet meal of seasoned ground beef browned with potatoes and onions.
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet, breaking into crumbles, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook parboiled diced potatoes and onions until crispy.
Return beef to the pan, toss together, and season to taste.

recipes.name: Black Bean Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Mexican-inspired nutrient-dense bowl of rice, canned black beans, onions, and avocado.
instructions: Warm cooked white rice and canned black beans in separate pans.
Assemble rice in bowls and top with beans and finely chopped raw red onion.
Garnish with fresh avocado slices.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: Light, crisp lettuce cups filled with flaked canned tuna and diced bell peppers.
instructions: Drain canned tuna and flake into a bowl.
Mix with finely diced bell peppers and lemon juice.
Spoon tuna mixture into large crisp lettuce leaves and serve.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
recipes.description: Energizing quick breakfast of whole wheat toast slathered with peanut butter and banana.
instructions: Toast the slices of whole wheat bread until golden brown.
Spread thick creamy peanut butter evenly across both slices.
Top with thin banana rounds and a light drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Creamy Spinach Pasta
recipes.description: Boiled pasta tossed in sautéed spinach, melted butter, and rich cheddar cheese.
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until tender; drain.
Melt butter in saucepan, wilt spinach with minced garlic.
Toss hot pasta with spinach, fold in grated cheddar until smooth and creamy.

recipes.name: Guacamole with Fresh Veggie Dippers
recipes.description: Creamy smashed avocado dip seasoned with tomato, onion, and lemon juice with carrot sticks.
instructions: Scoop ripe avocado flesh into a bowl and mash with a fork.
Fold in finely diced tomato, minced onion, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
Serve with fresh peeled carrot sticks for dipping.

recipes.name: Potato Leek Style Creamy Soup
recipes.description: Smooth vegetable soup made by simmering potatoes and onions in milk and butter.
instructions: Sauté chopped onions in butter until translucent.
Add peeled diced potatoes and water, boiling until potatoes are very soft.
Puree with warm milk until silky, seasoning with salt and white pepper.

recipes.name: Banana Strawberry Smoothie
recipes.description: Refreshing chilled fruit smoothie blending ripe banana, strawberries, and cold milk.
instructions: Place peeled banana, hulled strawberries, and cold milk into blender.
Blend on high until frothy and smooth.
Sweeten with honey to taste and pour into a tall glass.

recipes.name: Quick Vegetable Pasta Salad
recipes.description: Cold pasta salad tossed with diced bell peppers, carrots, tomatoes, and olive oil.
instructions: Cook pasta, drain, rinse with cold water, and let cool.
Finely dice bell pepper, carrot, and tomato.
Toss everything in a salad bowl with olive oil, salt, and herbs.

recipes.name: Simple Pan-Roasted Potatoes
recipes.description: Crispy pan-fried potato cubes with onions in golden butter.
instructions: Cut potatoes into small cubes and microwave or parboil for 4 minutes.
Melt butter in skillet, add potatoes and sliced onions.
Fry undisturbed until bottoms are golden and crispy, then flip and crisp other side.

recipes.name: Yogurt Potato Raita
recipes.description: Traditional cooling spiced yogurt side with boiled potato cubes and fresh lemon.
instructions: Whisk fresh yogurt until smooth.
Fold in diced boiled potatoes, roasted cumin, and salt.
Add a dash of fresh lemon juice and serve chilled.
